## Summary

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and related issues.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I checked existing issues and pull requests for duplicate or overlapping work.
- [ ] This change stays within the agreed scope and existing implementation languages.
- [ ] Borrowed/generated material has documented sources, permissions and attribution.
- [ ] My PR title follows the Conventional Commit format in AGENTS.md.
- [ ] I can respond to review feedback within one week.

## Validation

List the commands and results required by CONTRIBUTING.md for this change.
For gameplay changes, include Factorio/dependency versions, regression evidence
and graphical checks. Explain any checks you could not run; leave the PR as a
draft while required validation is missing.

- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] Applicable checks passed again after the latest update.

## Maintainer checklist

- [ ] Scope, attribution and validation are ready for merge.
- [ ] Only jatmn or a designated maintainer will merge this PR.
